common.permission.no_access_title.description: Title of the web no-access state shown when a member opens a section (Booking / Expenses / Inventory) their permissions do not allow them to view — e.g. via a direct URL.

common.permission.no_access_message.value: Ask the business owner for access.
common.permission.no_access_message.description: Body of the web no-access state under common.permission.no_access_title, telling the member the owner controls permissions.
